messages:
lina: New support case: user followed the docker quickstart (containerized sample) and the app printed 'request complete' but no generated text. They shared docker logs and a raw response snippet.

omar: can you paste the run command + any raw HTTP body they captured?

lina: command they ran (redacted):
```
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-xxxx redwood/hello:latest
```
App stdout:
```
Starting request to model=open-7b
Waiting for stream...
Stream closed
Request complete
```
They attached tcpdump of the response body (sanitized):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
content-length: 128

{"id":"r_abc","status":"blocked","reason":"billing_contact_missing","message":"Workspace missing billing contact; set a billing email to enable generation","streaming":false}
```
Connection reset right after body.

omar: interesting - server returned 200 with status=blocked and streaming=false. Which SDK inside the container?

lina: go-sdk v0.7.0 in the container (image built from the quickstart Dockerfile). The same user tried the python quickstart locally and got an explicit exception: "BillingRequiredError: workspace billing contact missing". So parity gap between go and py.

omar: why did go treat this as success?

lina: looks like the go streaming reader treats any 200 with a single JSON then EOF as an empty stream and returns a zero-length result rather than surfacing the error in the body. The python SDK inspects error structure and raises.

omar: that's a bug in SDK parity + a server mismatch. Two fixes: server should prefer 402/403 for gating so clients get a clear status code; SDKs must also detect sentinel bodies like reason=="billing_contact_missing" regardless of status.

billing-bot: FYI this workspace was created via SSO provisioning. Our SSO connector flow creates workspaces and admin users but we don't automatically set a billing contact for orgs that sign up via SCIM. That can leave them in a state where preview/blocked responses are used. We record the attempt footprint but don't bill. Dashboard team: we'll add a tooltip to clarify preview vs billed usage.

cs: user asked what to do now. Any quick unblock?

omar: workaround: set a billing contact on the workspace. In console: go to Settings -> Billing -> Add billing contact. Or for org admins: `redwoodctl org update --id <org> --billing-email admin@example.com`. After that the first call flows normally.

lina: user accepted and confirmed the quickstart returned streaming text.

omar: action items: (1) Server: INF-4801 - make gating responses use 402/403 or add X-Redwood-Gating header so SDKs can detect reliably. (2) SDK: DX-9005 - go-sdk patch to treat reason=="billing_contact_missing" and other known sentinels as errors (don't return empty success), add parity tests across py/go/js/ruby. (3) Docs: add onboarding note about SSO/SCIM provisioning and billing contact requirement; CS canned reply with steps and CLI command. (4) Dashboard UX: add tooltip clarifying preview footprints vs invoiced usage.

sdk-bot: go-sdk@0.7.1 published (patch) - surfaces BillingRequiredError when server returns blocked/preview sentinel bodies; added integration test for 200-with-blocked-body.

billing-bot: Dashboard tooltip task filed: FIN-2334. Clarified: preview/blocked attempts are tracked for quota and debugging but are not billed.

omar: follow-ups: add a small smoke test in quickstart CI that runs the container against a workspace with billing disabled and asserts the sample prints a clear error, not a silent success.

lina: closing with docs PR link once merged; user happy. Thanks everyone :tada:
